SELECT d.id AS destination_id, d.region_id AS region_id, dt.name, ( SELECT di.image_url FROM destination_images di WHERE di.destination_id = d.id AND di.is_main = 1 ORDER BY di.order_index ASC, di.id ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS image_url, cc.region_name AS region_name, pcc.id AS parent_region_id, pcc.region_name AS parent_region_name, d.season, c.id AS category_id, c.name AS category_name FROM destinations d JOIN categories c ON c.name = #{categoryName} LEFT JOIN destination_translations dt ON d.id = dt.destination_id AND dt.language_code = 'ko' LEFT JOIN country_categories cc ON d.region_id = cc.id
LEFT JOIN country_categories pcc ON cc.parent_id = pcc.id WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM destination_categories dc WHERE dc.destination_id = d.id AND dc.category_id = c.id ) AND d.is_public = 1 ORDER BY RAND() LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT d.id AS destination_id, d.region_id AS region_id, dt.name, ( SELECT di.image_url FROM destination_images di WHERE di.destination_id = d.id AND di.is_main = 1 ORDER BY di.order_index ASC, di.id ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS image_url, cc.region_name AS region_name, pcc.id AS parent_region_id, pcc.region_name AS parent_region_name, d.season, NULL AS category_id, NULL AS category_name FROM destinations d LEFT JOIN destination_translations dt ON d.id = dt.destination_id AND dt.language_code = 'ko' LEFT JOIN country_categories cc ON d.region_id = cc.id LEFT JOIN country_categories pcc ON cc.parent_id = pcc.id WHERE d.season = #{season} AND d.is_public = 1 ORDER BY RAND() LIMIT #{limit}

WITH RECURSIVE domestic_regions AS ( SELECT id FROM country_categories WHERE code = 'KR' UNION ALL SELECT child.id FROM country_categories child JOIN domestic_regions parent ON child.parent_id = parent.id ) SELECT d.id, (domestic.id IS NOT NULL) AS domestic, EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM destination_images di LEFT JOIN destination_image_sources s ON s.destination_image_id = di.id WHERE di.id = (SELECT main.id FROM destination_images main WHERE main.destination_id = d.id AND main.is_main = 1 AND TRIM(main.image_url) <> '' ORDER BY main.order_index, main.id LIMIT 1) AND (CASE WHEN s.destination_image_id IS NOT NULL THEN s.license_type ELSE di.license_type END) = 'KOGL_TYPE_3' ) AS imageNoDerivatives FROM destinations d JOIN destination_translations dt ON dt.destination_id = d.id AND dt.language_code = 'ko' JOIN country_categories cc ON cc.id = d.region_id LEFT JOIN domestic_regions domestic ON domestic.id = d.region_id WHERE

SELECT d.id AS destination_id, d.region_id AS region_id, dt.name, ( SELECT di.image_url FROM destination_images di WHERE di.destination_id = d.id AND di.is_main = 1 AND TRIM(di.image_url) <> '' ORDER BY di.order_index ASC, di.id ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS image_url, cc.region_name AS region_name, pcc.id AS parent_region_id, pcc.region_name AS parent_region_name, d.season, NULL AS category_id, NULL AS category_name FROM ( SELECT dvd.destination_id, SUM(dvd.view_count) AS recent_views FROM destination_view_daily dvd JOIN destinations candidate ON candidate.id = dvd.destination_id AND candidate.is_public = 1 WHERE dvd.view_date BETWEEN #{fromDate} AND #{toDate} GROUP BY dvd.destination_id ORDER BY recent_views DESC, dvd.destination_id ASC LIMIT #{limit} ) recent JOIN destinations d ON d.id = recent.destination_id LEFT JOIN destination_translations dt ON d.id = dt.destination_id AND dt.language_code = 'ko' LEFT JOIN country_categories cc ON d.region_id = cc.id LEFT JOIN country_categories pcc ON cc.parent_id = pcc.id WHERE d.is_public = 1 ORDER BY recent.recent_views DESC, recent.destination_id ASC
